description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Credentials HTTP endpoint of the Eclipse Hono Device Registry. It verifies credential management functionalities such as adding, updating, retrieving, and handling various edge cases through HTTP requests, using the Vert.x testing framework and JUnit.

classes.name: CredentialsHttpIT
classes.description: Contains integration tests for the Credentials HTTP API, covering credential addition, retrieval, update, and error scenarios.

methods.name: setUpClient
methods.description: Initializes the static DeviceRegistryHttpClient before any tests run.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test fixture by registering a new device before each test.

methods.name: removeCredentials
methods.description: Deletes the test device after each test run.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the Vertx instance after all tests are complete.

methods.name: testAddCredentialsSucceeds
methods.description: Tests successful addition of credentials.

methods.name: testNewDeviceReturnsEmptyCredentials
methods.description: Verifies that a new device initially has no credentials.

methods.name: testAddCredentialsSucceedsForAdditionalProperties
methods.description: Ensures credentials with additional properties can be added successfully.

methods.name: testAddCredentialsFailsForWrongContentType
methods.description: Checks proper rejection for wrong content types when adding credentials.

methods.name: testUpdateCredentialsWithOutdatedResourceVersionFails
methods.description: Ensures update fails if resource version is outdated.

methods.name: testAddCredentialsFailsForBCryptWithTooManyIterations
methods.description: Verifies request rejection for bcrypt hashes with too many iterations.

methods.name: testAddCredentialsFailsForEmptyBody
methods.description: Checks rejection when an empty payload is submitted.

methods.name: testAddCredentialsFailsForMissingType
methods.description: Ensures missing type field results in rejection.

methods.name: testAddCredentialsFailsForMissingAuthId
methods.description: Ensures missing authId field results in rejection.

methods.name: testUpdateCredentialsSucceeds
methods.description: Verifies updating existing credentials successfully.

methods.name: testUpdateCredentialsSucceedsForClearTextPassword
methods.description: Verifies that credentials can be updated with cleartext passwords (ignored in current test).

methods.name: testUpdateCredentialsFailsForNonExistingCredentials
methods.description: Ensures update fails if credentials do not exist.

methods.name: testGetAddedCredentials
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of credentials that have been added.

methods.name: testAddedCredentialsContainsEtag
methods.description: Checks that added credentials include an ETag header.

methods.name: testGetAddedCredentialsMultipleTypesSingleRequests
methods.description: Verifies multiple credentials of different types can be retrieved in a single request.

methods.name: testGetAllCredentialsForDeviceSucceeds
methods.description: Ensures all credentials for a device are retrieved correctly.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsForDeviceRegardlessOfType
methods.description: Checks retrieval of all credentials regardless of type.

methods.name: testGetAddedCredentialsButWithWrongType
methods.description: Verifies retrieval fails with wrong credential type.

methods.name: testGetAddedCredentialsButWithWrongAuthId
methods.description: Verifies retrieval fails with wrong authId.
